items.title: RAGShaper: Eliciting Sophisticated Agentic RAG Skills via Automated Data Synthesis
items.title_zh: RAGShaper：通过自动化数据合成激发复杂的智能体 RAG 技能
items.summary: RAGShaper is a data-synthesis framework for agentic RAG that builds dense information trees with adversarial distractors at perception and cognition levels, then uses constrained navigation to force a teacher agent to demonstrate error correction and noise rejection. Models trained on the synthesized corpus reportedly outperform existing baselines and show greater robustness on noise-intensive and complex retrieval tasks.

items.title: colbymchenry/codegraph
items.title_zh: colbymchenry/codegraph：面向编程智能体的本地代码知识图谱
items.summary: codegraph is a C project that provides a pre-indexed code knowledge graph which syncs automatically when code changes, aimed at coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Cursor, and OpenCode. It is described as fully local and as reducing token use and tool calls.

items.title: Grounding Agent Memory in Contextual Intent
items.title_zh: 将智能体记忆锚定于情境意图
items.summary: STITCH indexes each step of a long-horizon agent trajectory with a structured "contextual intent" cue—latent goal, action type, and salient entity types—and retrieves history by matching the current step's intent. Across the new CAME-Bench and LongMemEval it reports state-of-the-art results, beating the strongest baseline by 35.6%, with gains growing as trajectories lengthen.

items.title: BibAgent: An Agentic Framework for Traceable Miscitation Detection in Scientific Literature
items.title_zh: BibAgent：面向科学文献可追溯错误引用检测的智能体框架
items.summary: BibAgent is an end-to-end agentic framework for citation verification that combines retrieval, reasoning and adaptive evidence aggregation, using an Evidence Committee mechanism to infer citation validity for paywalled references. The authors contribute a five-category miscitation taxonomy and MisciteBench, a cross-disciplinary benchmark of 6,350 miscitation samples spanning 254 fields, and report better accuracy and interpretability than LLM baselines.

items.title: LSTM-MAS: A Long Short-Term Memory Inspired Multi-Agent System for Long-Context Understanding
items.title_zh: LSTM-MAS：受长短期记忆启发的长上下文多智能体系统
items.summary: LSTM-MAS is a chained multi-agent system inspired by LSTM gates for long-context understanding, with worker, filter, judge, and manager agents controlling information flow between segments. Compared with the prior CoA multi-agent approach, it reports gains of 97.97%, 65.75%, 122.19%, 39.61%, and 10.80% on NarrativeQA, Qasper, HotpotQA, 2WikiMQA, and MuSiQue.

items.title: Benchmarking Small Language Models and Small Reasoning Language Models on System Log Severity Classification
items.title_zh: 小语言模型与小推理模型在系统日志严重性分类上的基准测试
items.summary: Using real journalctl data from Linux production servers, the authors evaluate nine models drawn from small language models and small reasoning language models under zero-shot, few-shot and RAG prompting, treating severity classification as a probe of runtime log comprehension. Qwen3-4B reaches 95.64% with RAG and Gemma3-1B improves from 20.25% to 85.28%, while several small reasoning models degrade substantially when paired with retrieval.

items.title: Exploring the Meta-level Reasoning of Large Language Models via a Tool-based Multi-hop Tabular Question Answering Task
items.title_zh: 通过基于工具的多跳表格问答任务探索大语言模型的元级推理
items.summary: The authors distinguish meta-level reasoning, or reasoning about the intermediate steps needed for a task, from object-level execution, and design a tool-based multi-hop tabular QA task over geopolitical indicators with "essential actions" for comparing tool calls. They find LLMs show good meta-level reasoning but flawed task understanding, that n-shot prompting has little effect on accuracy, and provide further evidence of poor numeracy.

items.title: ART: Action-based Reasoning Task Benchmarking for Medical AI Agents
items.title_zh: ART：面向医疗 AI 智能体的基于行动的推理任务基准
items.summary: ART is an action-based reasoning benchmark for medical AI agents that mines real electronic health record data into tasks targeting threshold evaluation, temporal aggregation and conditional logic. On 600 tasks, GPT-4o-mini and Claude 3.5 Sonnet show near-perfect retrieval after prompt refinement but substantial gaps in aggregation (28% to 64%) and threshold reasoning (32% to 38%).

items.title: OpenDecoder: Open Large Language Model Decoding to Incorporate Document Quality in RAG
items.title_zh: OpenDecoder：在 RAG 中引入文档质量的开放大模型解码
items.summary: OpenDecoder passes explicit signals about retrieved documents, such as relevance, ranking and query-performance-prediction scores, into the LLM's generation step. The authors report improved robustness and results over baselines on five benchmark datasets.

items.title: Continuum Memory Architectures for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
items.title_zh: 面向长时程 LLM 智能体的连续记忆架构
items.summary: The paper characterizes Continuum Memory Architecture as a family of systems that maintain and revise internal state using persistent storage, selective retention, associative routing, temporal chaining and consolidation. Its argument is that the stateless lookup approach of RAG is inadequate for agents operating over long horizons.

items.title: Patient-Similarity Cohort Reasoning in Clinical Text-to-SQL
items.title_zh: 临床 Text-to-SQL 中的患者相似性队列推理
items.summary: CLINSQL is a new benchmark of 633 tasks annotated by experts on MIMIC-IV v3.1, where success requires multi-table joins, clinically meaningful filters and runnable SQL over time windows and patient-similarity groups. Across 22 models, results remain short of clinical reliability: GPT-5-mini scores 74.7% on execution, DeepSeek-R1 is the best open-source model at 69.2%, and Gemini-2.5-Pro falls from 85.5% on Easy to 67.2% on Hard.

items.title: A self-evolving multi-role collaborative framework with fine-grained difficulty guidance for innovative mathematical problem generation
items.title_zh: 面向创新数学问题生成的自进化多角色协作框架与细粒度难度引导
items.summary: The paper proposes innovative math problem generation and a self-evolving multi-role framework with a sampler, generator, evaluator, state machine and memory, using iterative self-assessment and external feedback. It adds a difficulty model with association-guided path sampling and a multi-stage training pipeline, reporting improved innovation while maintaining a high correctness rate.

items.title: How Much Would a Clinician Edit This Draft? Evaluating LLM Alignment for Patient Message Response Drafting
items.title_zh: 临床医生会如何修改这份草稿？评估 LLM 在患者消息回复起草中的对齐
items.summary: The authors develop a taxonomy of thematic elements in clinician responses and an evaluation framework for assessing clinician editing load of LLM-drafted patient portal messages at content and theme levels. Testing thematic prompting, retrieval-augmented generation, supervised fine-tuning and direct preference optimization, they find substantial epistemic uncertainty in aligning drafts with individual clinicians, with particular difficulty in question asking to elicit further information.

items.title: Analyzing Cancer Patients' Experiences with Embedding-based Topic Modeling and LLMs
items.title_zh: 结合嵌入主题建模与大语言模型分析癌症患者体验
items.summary: The study applies neural topic modeling to 13 transcribed interviews with cancer patients (132,722 words), comparing BERTopic and Top2Vec and using GPT-4 for topic labeling. Domain-specific clinical embeddings improved topic precision and interpretability, with BioClinicalBERT giving the most consistent results; the authors note the text was machine-translated from Dutch and that clinicians were not involved in the evaluation.

items.title: Learn Like Humans: Use Meta-cognitive Reflection for Efficient Self-Improvement
items.title_zh: 像人类一样学习：利用元认知反思实现高效自我改进
items.summary: MARS is a self-improvement framework that updates an agent's instructions within a single recurrence cycle by combining principle-based reflection, which abstracts rules that avoid errors, with procedural reflection, which derives step-by-step strategies. Across six benchmarks it is reported to outperform state-of-the-art self-evolving systems while significantly reducing computational overhead.

items.title: A Cloud-based Multi-Agentic Workflow for Science
items.title_zh: 面向科学的云端多智能体工作流
items.summary: The paper presents a domain-agnostic, model-independent cloud workflow in which a supervisor agent coordinates specialized agents for literature review, data analysis, and simulation. In a catalyst-focused proof of concept, it routed tasks to the correct agent 90% of the time and completed 97.5% of synthetic tasks and 91% of real-world tasks.

items.title: Disagreement as Data: Reasoning Trace Analytics in Multi-Agent Systems
items.title_zh: 把分歧当作数据：多智能体系统中的推理轨迹分析
items.summary: The study treats reasoning traces from multi-agent LLM systems as process data for qualitative coding and uses cosine similarity to detect disagreement across nearly 10,000 agent-pair coding instances. It finds that semantic reasoning similarity separates consensus from disagreement and correlates with human coding reliability.

items.title: Zero-Shot Embedding Drift Detection: A Lightweight Defense Against Prompt Injections in LLMs
items.title_zh: 零样本嵌入漂移检测：抵御大语言模型提示注入的轻量防御
items.summary: ZEDD detects direct and indirect prompt injection by measuring semantic drift in embedding space between benign and suspect inputs, using adversarial-clean prompt pairs and cosine similarity without model internals or attack-specific training. On a re-annotated LLMail-Inject dataset it reports over 93% classification accuracy across Llama 3, Qwen 2, and Mistral with a false positive rate below 3%.

items.title: Beyond Single-Shot: Multi-step Tool Retrieval via Query Planning
items.title_zh: 超越单次检索：通过查询规划实现多步工具检索
items.summary: TOOLQP models tool retrieval as iterative query planning, decomposing an instruction into sub-tasks and dynamically generating queries instead of relying on single-shot dense matching. It is trained on synthetic query trajectories with reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards and reports state-of-the-art performance, zero-shot generalization and downstream agentic gains.

items.title: MemoBrain: Executive Memory as an Agentic Brain for Reasoning
items.title_zh: MemoBrain：作为推理代理大脑的执行记忆
items.summary: MemoBrain is proposed as an executive memory layer for agents that use tools, maintaining a dependency-aware record of reasoning steps while discarding invalid ones and collapsing finished sub-trajectories so the core reasoning trace fits a fixed context budget. The authors report gains over strong baselines on GAIA, WebWalker and BrowseComp-Plus.

items.title: From Rows to Reasoning: A Retrieval-Augmented Multimodal Framework for Spreadsheet Understanding
items.title_zh: 从行到推理：面向电子表格理解的多模态检索增强框架
items.summary: The authors introduce FRTR-Bench, a benchmark of 30 enterprise Excel workbooks spanning nearly four million cells and more than 50 embedded images, and propose FRTR, a multimodal RAG framework that decomposes workbooks into row, column and block embeddings with hybrid lexical-dense retrieval and reciprocal rank fusion. FRTR reaches 74% answer accuracy with Claude Sonnet 4.5 versus 24% for prior state-of-the-art approaches, and 87% on SpreadsheetLLM with GPT-5 while cutting token usage by roughly half.

items.title: Aeon: High-Performance Neuro-Symbolic Memory Management for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
items.title_zh: Aeon：面向长时程 LLM 智能体的高性能神经符号记忆管理
items.summary: Aeon is a neuro-symbolic cognitive operating system that treats memory as a managed resource, organizing it into a Memory Palace spatial index built on a SIMD-accelerated page-clustered vector index and a neuro-symbolic episodic graph called the Trace. It introduces symmetric INT8 scalar quantization for 3.1x spatial compression, a write-ahead log for crash recoverability, and a semantic lookaside buffer designed to exploit conversational locality, with benchmarks run on Apple M4 Max.

items.title: Digital Metabolism: Decoupling Logic from Facts via Regenerative Unlearning -- Towards a Pure Neural Logic Core
items.title_zh: 数字代谢：通过再生式遗忘将逻辑与事实解耦——迈向纯神经逻辑核心
items.summary: The authors propose "digital metabolism," a thermodynamic hypothesis that targeted forgetting is needed to distill a pure neural logic core by decoupling reasoning from factual knowledge in shared weights. Applying their Regenerative Logic-Core Protocol to Qwen2.5-0.5B produced near-zero retention of targeted facts (accuracy below 7%) and behavior the authors interpret as spontaneous chain-of-thought scaffolding on GSM8K, though they say the causal mechanism needs further study.

items.title: AI Co-Scientist for Knowledge Synthesis in Medical Contexts: A Proof of Concept
items.title_zh: 面向医学场景知识合成的 AI 联合科学家：概念验证
items.summary: The authors describe an AI co-scientist that helps synthesize biomedical evidence by formalizing PICOS and combining relational storage, vector search and a Neo4j knowledge graph inside a RAG pipeline. Their PubMedBERT classifier identified study designs with 95.7% accuracy, and a Bi-LSTM detected PICOS compliance at 87%.

items.title: MHA2MLA-VLM: Enabling DeepSeek's Economical Multi-Head Latent Attention across Vision-Language Models
items.title_zh: MHA2MLA-VLM：将 DeepSeek 的经济型多头潜在注意力引入视觉语言模型
items.summary: MHA2MLA-VLM is a parameter-efficient, multimodal-aware framework for converting off-the-shelf vision-language models to Multi-Head Latent Attention, using a modality-adaptive partial-RoPE strategy and modality-decoupled low-rank approximation of visual and textual KV spaces. Experiments on three representative VLMs show it restores original model performance with minimal supervised data while significantly reducing KV-cache footprint and integrating with KV quantization.

items.title: Assessing LLM Reliability on Temporally Recent Open-Domain Questions
items.title_zh: 评估大语言模型在时效性开放域问题上的可靠性
items.summary: RECOM is a benchmark of 15,000 recent Reddit questions from September 2025 paired with community-derived reference answers, used to evaluate four open-source LLMs. The authors report a semantic-lexical paradox, with over 99% cosine similarity despite under 8% BLEU-1 overlap, and find that scale did not predict performance, as Mistral-7B outperformed GPT-OSS-20B on all metrics.

items.title: To Copy or Not to Copy: Copying Is Easier to Induce Than Recall
items.title_zh: 复制还是不复制：复制比回忆更容易被诱发
items.summary: Extracting an arbitration vector from model activations across 27 relations, the authors steer whether retrieval-augmented models rely on parametric knowledge or copy from context in three architectures and two open-domain QA benchmarks. They find an asymmetry: inducing copying is an easy reactivation that can be triggered from different input locations, while restoring recall is a more fragile suppression tied to object-token interventions.

items.title: Agentic Artificial Intelligence (AI): Architectures, Taxonomies, and Evaluation of Large Language Model Agents
items.title_zh: 智能体 AI：大语言模型智能体的架构、分类与评估
items.summary: The paper proposes a unified taxonomy for agentic AI that decomposes agents into perception, brain, planning, action, tool use, and collaboration, and traces the shift from linear reasoning to inference-time reasoning models and from fixed API calls to standards such as MCP. It also groups operating environments and reviews evaluation practices, flagging challenges including hallucination in action, infinite loops, and prompt injection.

items.title: RAPTOR-AI for Disaster OODA Loop: Hierarchical Multimodal RAG with Experience-Driven Agentic Decision-Making
items.title_zh: RAPTOR-AI：面向灾害 OODA 回路的层次化多模态 RAG 与经验驱动智能体决策
items.summary: RAPTOR-AI is an agentic multimodal RAG framework for disaster response that builds hierarchical knowledge trees from 46 tsunami-related PDFs (2,378 pages) using BLIP image understanding, ColVBERT embeddings, and long-context summarization inside an OODA loop. It reports 23% better retrieval precision, 31% better situational grounding, and 27% improved task decomposition, scaling to 3,000 document chunks.

items.title: colbymchenry/codegraph
items.title_zh: colbymchenry/codegraph：面向编程智能体的本地代码知识图谱
items.summary: codegraph is a C project that provides a pre-indexed code knowledge graph which syncs automatically when code changes, aimed at coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Cursor, and OpenCode. It is described as fully local and as reducing token use and tool calls.

items.title: felinics/Memoh
items.title_zh: felinics/Memoh：为每个智能体提供独立计算机与长期记忆的多智能体平台
items.summary: Memoh is an open-source multi-agent platform written in Go in which each agent gets a separate computer, desktop, network and long-term memory. It supports bring-your-own-key setups and can host coding agents including Claude Code and Codex.

items.title: OpenCoworkAI/open-cowork
items.title_zh: OpenCoworkAI/open-cowork：一键安装 Claude Code 与 MCP 工具的桌面智能体
items.summary: open-cowork is an open-source desktop agent application for Windows and macOS that can set up Claude Code, MCP tools and Skills with a single click. It adds sandbox isolation, support for multiple models, and Feishu/Slack integration.

items.title: Q00/ouroboros
items.title_zh: Q00/ouroboros：可自我进化的 Agent OS
items.summary: Ouroboros calls itself an "agent OS" and describes an evolution loop that is gated by an interview, evaluated in stages and run under a budget. It includes an MCP server that works with 14 runtimes, among them Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI and OpenCode.

items.title: alvinunreal/oh-my-opencode-slim
items.title_zh: alvinunreal/oh-my-opencode-slim：精简的 OpenCode 多代理套件
items.summary: oh-my-opencode-slim is described as a lean, fine-tuned multi-agent suite for OpenCode that can mix any models and automatically delegate tasks; GitHub lists TypeScript as the repository language.

items.title: michaelshimeles/ralphy
items.title_zh: michaelshimeles/ralphy：循环调用编码代理直到 PRD 完成
items.summary: Ralphy is an autonomous Bash script that loops Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor's agent, Qwen, and Droid until a product requirements document is finished; GitHub lists TypeScript for the repository.

items.title: sickn33/agentic-awesome-skills
items.title_zh: sickn33/agentic-awesome-skills：Agent 技能控制平面
items.summary: AAS Core describes itself as a local, agent-first control plane that covers catalog discovery, agent-owned skill selection, stack validation and planning. It draws on more than 2,750 agentic skills and ships with a CLI, a local MCP server and a Workbench.

items.title: Ask HN: How are you doing RAG locally?
items.title_zh: Ask HN：你如何在本地运行 RAG？
items.summary: A Hacker News Ask HN discussion asks developers how they run RAG on their own machines with few dependencies for internal code or complicated documents, and which backends they choose: vector databases, semantic search, knowledge graphs or hypergraphs.

items.title: A Practical Guide to Building AI Agents
items.title_zh: 构建 AI 智能体的实用指南
items.summary: OpenAI published a guide to designing, orchestrating, and deploying AI agents that covers use cases, model selection, tool design, guardrails, and multi-agent patterns.

items.title: Building with the GPT-5 Model Series: A Practical Guide
items.title_zh: 使用 GPT-5 模型系列构建应用：实用指南
items.summary: OpenAI published a practical guide for startups on migrating to the Responses API, designing agents, tuning prompts, steering GPT-5 models, and building reliable AI workflows.
